data.one_liner: Widget that animates a child into view with optional delay and direction
data.what_it_does: ShowUpAnimation slides a widget into view from a specified direction after an optional delay. ShowUpList applies the same animation to a list of widgets with staggered timing.
use_when: Creating simple entrance animations for individual widgets
Building lists with staggered show‑up effects
Adding onboarding or tutorial screens with minimal code
avoid_when: Complex physics‑based or custom motion curves beyond simple slide
High‑performance animations that require low‑level control
strengths: Supports both single widgets and lists
Customizable delay, duration, curve, direction and offset
weaknesses: No support for advanced physics or custom motion paths
Not suitable for heavy animation workloads

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broader set of implicit animations and can replace ShowUpAnimation for similar slide‑in effects

data.minimal_example:
ShowUpAnimation(
  delayStart: Duration(seconds: 1),
  animationDuration: Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.bounceIn,
  direction: Direction.vertical,
  offset: 0.5,
  child: YourWidget(),
),
